$comment: promptwise's say over the registry. `hidden`: items Studio's catalog in the Timeline tab does not list (the files stay, so `hyperframes add` still installs them). `use`: the items the agent is offered first, each with when and where to use it; the agent reads them as /opt/hyperframes/catalog.md. Names are registry names (registry/blocks/<name> or registry/components/<name>). Checked by scripts/promptwise-catalog.mjs at build.

use.caption-word-pop: Default subtitles for talking-head, UGC and Reels/TikTok edits: one word at a time over the picture. add_subtitles installs and fills it; use it by hand only when that tool can't.
use.caption-pill-karaoke: Subtitles when the user asks for karaoke or a calmer, brand-y look than word-pop: a pill with the spoken word highlighted.
use.caption-highlight: TikTok-style subtitles with a coloured sweep behind the active word; for energetic short-form when the user wants highlighted words.
use.caption-kinetic-slam: One big word at a time, full screen, for a hook (first 2-3 s) or a punchline, not for whole-video subtitles.
use.caption-emoji-pop: Playful subtitles with emoji next to key words, for lifestyle and UGC content when the user asks for emoji.
use.whip-pan-cut: Cut between two clips with energy: a fast lateral whip. Use on a beat or a change of topic in short-form; at most two or three per video.
use.zoom-through-transition: Transition into a new section: zooms through a card into the next scene. Good between chapters of an explainer or a product video.
use.fade-through: Calm transition between two shots (fade through a wash). The safe default for slow, premium or emotional edits.
use.directional-wipe: Push transition that slides one scene over another; for listicles and step-by-step content (next point, next step).
use.match-cut: Graphic match cut on a circle; for a stylish reveal between two related shots, not as a routine cut.
use.lt-clean-bar: Name and role of a speaker in an interview or podcast (16:9), shown 3-5 s after they first appear.
use.lt-soft-pill: Softer lower third (name and role in a white pill) for friendly or lifestyle talking-head content.
use.lt-kicker-name: Lower third without a card, for footage where a box would cover too much: a kicker tag, the name and a line.
use.news-ticker: Breaking-news style ticker with a headline and scrolling crawl; only when the user wants a news or broadcast look.
use.tiktok-follow: "Follow" call to action for a TikTok account (9:16), at the end or after the hook. Fill in the user's handle and avatar.
use.instagram-follow: "Follow" call to action for an Instagram account (9:16), at the end or after the hook. Fill in the user's handle and avatar.
use.x-post: Show a tweet or X post as a card, when the video quotes or reacts to a post.
use.titlecard-lockup: Opening or chapter title with a brand wordmark that holds still; for brand and product videos.
use.titlecard-calm: Minimal opening or chapter title (kicker and headline) for explainers and premium edits.
use.cta-lockup: Closing call to action (action line, button, small print) at the end of an ad or a product video.
use.cta-close: Big closing call to action that fills the frame; for the last 2-3 s of a short ad.
use.logo-brand-close: Brand outro: the wordmark, tagline and URL, held to the end of the video.
use.social-proof-card: App or product close with stars, a proof line, three features and a CTA; for app ads.
use.testimonial-card: Customer quote with author and rating, for social proof in ads and UGC compilations.
use.count-up: Animated number (a stat, a price, followers) counting up to its value; for results and proof beats.
use.push-in: Slow camera push on a headline, for a calm emphasis beat between clips.
use.yt-camera-move: Zoom, slide and tilt helpers for a clip or a card: punch-ins on a talking head to keep long shots alive.
use.camera-shake: Handheld or impact shake on a clip; for a hit, a drop or a surprise, briefly.
use.yt-feather-highlight: Dim everything but one area of the frame, to point at a detail in a screen recording or a product shot.
use.hw-arrow: Hand-drawn arrow that points at something in the frame; for tutorials, reviews and UGC call-outs.
use.hw-callout-circle: Hand-drawn circle with a label around something in the frame; for tutorials and reviews.
use.yt-circle-pointer: Circle around a target with a countdown chip; for "watch this" moments in tutorials.
use.chart-story: Any chart from the user's own numbers (bars, a line with area, a donut or progress bars) that lands the exact values; for results, stats and proof beats in explainers and ads. Set its data, labels and unit variables.
use.mk-line-graph: A minimal line graph of one or two series drawn on with value labels; for growth over time in a 16:9 explainer.
use.bar-chart-race: Ranked bars overtaking each other over periods; only when the user has a ranking that changes over time.
use.world-map: World map with countries revealed and coloured by value; for where something happens or a global reach beat. Use a 16:9 layout or check it in 9:16.
use.us-map: US map with states coloured by value and a legend; for US-only data or reach.
use.nyc-paris-flight: A plane flying a route on a realistic map with a landing pop; for travel, shipping or 'from here to there' beats. Change the two places to the user's.
use.logo-wall: Trusted-by wall of logos; for a social proof beat in a B2B or product ad. Replace the placeholder lettermarks with the user's real client logos.
use.star-rating-fill: Star row that fills to a rating (4.8 out of 5); for a review or app-store rating proof beat.
